name: camoucore-camouwolf
author: JWriter20
description: Camouwolf: TypeScript launcher for the Camouwolf anti-detect Chromium browser. A port of the Python launcher.
//playwright-core: Range mirrors python/pyproject.toml's `playwright = "<1.63"`: src/switches.ts restates the --disable-features list of Playwright's Chromium launch, so the ceiling is bumped deliberately, checking chromiumSwitches against PLAYWRIGHT_DISABLED_FEATURES. The dev pin (1.62.0) is the version the Python venv resolves, so the goldens compare like with like.
//@jwriter20/myuri: Pinned to the release python/pyproject.toml pins, so a humanize seed plans the same input in both launchers.
//captchakraken: The captcha option's solver, optional: a launch with captcha set and none installed throws CaptchaKrakenMissing. The dev pin lets the tests build a solver.
//engines: 22.15 for node:zlib zstd, which the fpgen model archive needs.
